state:
TASK T0:
Add a quick-exit path to ops-stop-hook.sh: when .operator/pending/ does not exist, exit 0 before sourcing partition.sh, with a case timing both paths.

TASK T1:
Make the cap scan cheaper: cache scan_caps on the ledger's content hash so a Stop with an unchanged ledger does not re-read it; add the same-size edit case.

TASK T2:
Implement the fast path in statusline.sh for a project with no .operator/ directory, keeping the 300ms render budget; add a timing case.

TASK T3:
Document in LANDMINES.md why the urgent-stop marker in .stopguard/ is wiped every SessionStart, quoting the #123 cases.

TASK T4:
Rename the 'trivial' fixture in tests/test-scripts.sh to 'minimal-ledger' across its four uses.

TASK T5:
Decide whether the cheapest-tier default for MECHANICAL should be glm-5.3-flash or haiku, using the grades.json scores and prices.
